description: This file defines the TokenProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, implementing various static methods to create, chain, memoize, cache, and manage token providers for AWS authentication. It handles tokens such as SSO tokens and includes methods to load AWS profiles and integrate with caching mechanisms.

classes.name: TokenProvider
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate and manipulate token provider functions for AWS SDK authentication, including default providers, chaining, memoization, and caching strategies.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default token provider that checks for cached AWS SSO tokens and combines multiple sources into a chain.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates a token provider function that returns a static token wrapped in a promise.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Creates an aggregate token provider that invokes multiple providers sequentially until one returns a token.

methods.name: memoize
methods.description: Wraps a token provider and caches its token, refreshing when it expires.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Wraps a token provider with caching logic, storing tokens in an AWS CacheInterface.

methods.name: loadDefaultProfiles
methods.description: Loads AWS profiles from the ~/.aws/config file.

methods.name: sso
methods.description: Creates an SSO token provider based on a profile name and credentials file.
